| 1 | 2025-11-22 | 0899907f... | $49.99 | Defective | **Approved** | No |

**Both refunds are already marked as approved in the system.** No further approval action is needed.

**Policy Notes to Be Aware Of (for your own records)**

- **Rule 2** — Defective items are eligible for a refund up to 90 days from purchase. Both requests were submitted within that window (6 days and 3 days after the respective order dates), so both are within policy.
- **Rule 6** — Refunds over $200 require manager approval. At $49.99 each, neither hits that threshold.

input.query: SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name, o.id AS order_id, o.status AS order_status, o.order_date, p.name AS product_name, oi.id AS order_item_id, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price_cents, r.id AS refund_id, r.amount_cents, r.reason, r.status AS refund_status, r.requested_at, r.evidence_submitted FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN refunds r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE c.name = 'Ava Thompson' AND p.name ILIKE '%Bluetooth Headphones%'
input.intent: Find Ava Thompson's refund request for Bluetooth Headphones including order, product, and refund details.

output.sql_executed: SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name, o.id AS order_id, o.status AS order_status, o.order_date, p.name AS product_name, oi.id AS order_item_id, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price_cents, r.id AS refund_id, r.amount_cents, r.reason, r.status AS refund_status, r.requested_at, r.evidence_submitted FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE c.name = 'Ava Thompson' AND p.name ILIKE '%Bluetooth Headphones%' LIMIT 500

Approval Threshold

A refund with an amount greater than $200 requires manager approval before the refund can be processed. The $200 approval threshold applies regardless of the refund's reason code.

Final-Sale Exclusion

Items in a `Clearance` or `Final Sale` product category are not eligible for a refund. An item in a `Clearance` or `Final Sale` product category may still be refunded under the `defective` reason code or the `wrong_item` reason code, per the 90-day defective-items window and the no-time-limit wrong-item-shipped rule.

`Clearance` and `Final Sale` are enforced as governed values via a CHECK constraint on `products.category`, not free text.
